Subject: ACME - GDPR DPA & SCC selection - recap and next steps

Hi Sofia 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Call highlights
- Scope: ACME will use Redwood Hosted API for customer-facing personalization features; ACME will remain the data controller.
- Compliance asks: DPA + SCCs for EU data transfers, copy of SOC 2 report, and completion of ACME security questionnaire.
- Subprocessors: we discussed Redwood's common subprocessors (cloud infra, logging).

Proposed immediate actions
1) Confirm roles: please confirm ACME's position as controller and Redwood as processor for the hosted flows (see question below).
2) We will provide our standard DPA and propose SCC modules. Our initial recommendation: Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) for primary flows; Module 3 for any processor->processor subprocessing.
3) I've attached a stub of our DPA template and a pointer to SOC 2 access instructions. Rishi (cc'd) will handle legal/DPA redlines.
4) Please send over the ACME security questionnaire ' happy to start it in parallel.

Next steps / timeline
- ACME: confirm roles and attach your questionnaire by EOD Thursday (2027-04-14).
- Redwood: share DPA & SOC 2 access by EOD Monday (2027-04-12); Rishi will share DocuSign link once you're ready to sign.

If that timeline works I'll mark the HubSpot deal and set up a 30-minute follow-up next week to close the DPA.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marissacole

Thanks Marissa ' good call. 

A few clarifications from our side: 
- Confirmed: ACME is the controller for the data in scope and Redwood will be a processor for the hosted API flows.
- SOC 2: we need either a SOC 2 Type II report or scoped SOC evidence for data handling. Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 posture and whether you can share the report under an NDA?
- Questionnaire: attaching our standard security questionnaire (ACME_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) ' can you have this completed by next Tuesday (2027-04-19)?
- DPA redlines: our legal team (legal@acmecorp.com) will review the DPA. We prefer SCC Module 2 for controller->processor flows; happy to discuss Module 3 for subprocessors.

Sofia Ramos

Hi Sofia '

Appreciate the confirmation on roles. Quick answers and next steps: 

SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our hosted API controls. We can provide the report via a secure link once an NDA is in place or via an access portal; instructions attached (Redwood_SOC2_Access_Instructions.txt). If you'd prefer, we can also arrange a brief walkthrough with our security team.

Questionnaire: thanks for the attachment ' we'll start completing it today. Neha (cc'd, Security PM) will lead the questionnaire responses and target delivery by 2027-04-19.

DPA & SCCs: Rishi will coordinate legal redlines. Our recommendation (as discussed) is Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) for the primary data flows. For any subprocessors that process personal data on Redwood's behalf, we recommend Module 3 for processor->processor relationships. Rishi ' can you confirm and prepare a DPA with Module 2 as the baseline and include a clause covering subprocessors?

DocuSign & timeline: once we have initial redlines back from ACME legal, we'll surface a DocuSign for execution. 

Thanks ' let us know if ACME legal needs anything else to start review.

Best,
